name: codex-sync
description: Synchronize global Codex instructions, agent profiles, portable settings, Git marketplaces, and installed non-protected plugins through a Git repository.

interface.longDescription: Bind to a Git repository, pull configuration and exact non-protected Git marketplace/plugin sets with convergence verification, or push the current device using deterministic Git baselines and an engine-owned cache.
defaultPrompt: Set up Codex Sync on this device.
